speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are presenting with postpartum fever and abdominal tenderness; how many weeks postpartum are you, and have you had any recent vaginal examinations, procedures, or intercourse?

speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old woman. The patient is in the postpartum period after delivering an 11 pound boy vaginally at 40 weeks gestation. She experienced a prolonged course during labor. She reports increased frequency of urination and uterine tenderness. She also mentions a decrease in bowel sounds.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Postpartum Pelvic Infection (Endometritis) with possible bladder distension or ileus.

Based on your history of a prolonged labor, fever, and uterine tenderness, I suspect an infection of the uterus. The decreased bowel sounds and urinary frequency suggest the infection may be affecting your bladder or causing temporary paralysis of your bowel. Have you experienced any chills, foul-smelling discharge, or difficulty passing urine?

REQUEST TEST: CBC, CRP, Urinalysis, Blood Culture.
REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_Ultrasound.
